content: Vizard.ai: cloud AI clipping - scans long videos for engaging moments (topic relevance, pacing, delivery), one-click cuts, auto-reframe centering speakers faces for 9:16, auto captions with emojis and automatic B-roll, subtitle translation to 100+ languages, auto-drafted titles/descriptions/hashtags, crop/resize per platform, direct publishing to TikTok/YouTube Shorts/Instagram; free tier plus iOS mobile app. Sources: vizard.ai, klap.app review blog.
